ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** start a walk on a phone, stand still for about 20 s, capture nothing, and hold Stop (from the walk screen, then again from the recording bar). **Expect:** no replay plays; you are back where you were with the pill "Walk not kept." and Undo; Undo brings the walk back as an ordinary walk with its replay; force-quitting before tapping Undo or Close leaves the walk in Chronicle (EW1, EW7, EW9).
